query_text: 我是无辣不欢的人，想找一家把菜做得特别辣、辣度非常猛的馆子，有推荐吗？
requirement_text: 评论需直接证明这家店的菜真的极辣，一口就能感受到强烈的热辣。
evidence_span: I took one bite and DAM, everything was all of a sudden really hot.
evidence_context:
MOMMY!

The spice level here is ridiculous.  I don't think I am a lightweight but these folks DO NOT MESS AROUND.  You've got to be honest about your spice intake level because it will be super spicy even if you say "not too spicy".  

I couldn't finish the Dan Dan Noodles I ordered.  It looked awesome though.  I took one bite and DAM, everything was all of a sudden really hot.  I wanted to yank out my digestive track because I felt the burn all the way down.  The dry pot fish which came later also looked awesome and was equally spicy as well!  I drank like 4 glasses of water in like 10 mins.  I honestly couldn't doggie bag my leftovers fast enough to leave and get more liquids ASAP.  

The people behind the counter were super friendly and made solid recommendations.  They also brought my food to my table and refilled my water glass quickly.

query_text: 想吃一口就火辣冒汗的重辣料理，哪家店能把辣度真正做足？
requirement_text: 评论需表明店家标注或承诺的辣是真辣，实际菜品远远超过一般人承受的辣度。
evidence_span: Let me preface this next part with saying that I really enjoy spicy foods but this was way too spicy for me!!!
evidence_context:
Came here on a late Sunday afternoon looking for a table for 2 and had to wait 20 minutes. 

We both ordered the spicy ramen. I really liked that you could chose the saltiness and the way the noodles are cooked. 

The pork was soooo tasty! I would definitely recommend that. 

Let me preface this next part with saying that I really enjoy spicy foods but this was way too spicy for me!!! I couldn't really enjoy the flavor that much because it was that spicy!!


So buyers beware - when they say spicy they mean it!

query_text: 平时只吃重辣，想找一家连招牌辣味菜都够劲儿的餐厅，哪里合适？
requirement_text: 评论需证明店里的辣味菜品实际上确实带足辣度；若实际上完全没辣味即视为违反。
evidence_span: there was ZERO heat in the soup. If someone told me that this item was meant to be spicy, I wouldn't have believed them. It was less spicy than mild salsa.
evidence_context:
TLDR: Good pho, lively atmosphere, but not spicy enough.

I went with some family friends who are Vietnamese food experts (aka they are from vietnam and their mission in life is to hit up every pho place), so I deferred to their judgement. We ordered a platter type dish (quiche, pork, rice, veggies), chicken pho, spring rolls, and Bun Bo Hue, a spicy beef soup. I was really excited about the Bun Bo Hue, because I rarely see spicy items at Vietnamese places (although there is plenty of sriracha and chili jam-type condiments to add), but there was ZERO heat in the soup. If someone told me that this item was meant to be spicy, I wouldn't have believed them. It was less spicy than mild salsa. It was delicious, but not spicy. 

I appreciate the plant-filled decor (I'm a sucker for plant life), and this place was packed 45 minutes from closing time, so clearly it's popular.

query_text: 想涮一顿辣得够劲、汤底麻辣十足的火锅，请帮忙找个这样的地方。
requirement_text: 评论需说明特辣锅底确实麻辣够劲；若点了特辣却几乎不辣则视为违反。
evidence_span: We ordered extra spicy soup base, but it's not spicy at all, only a thin layer of chili oil floating on the top.
evidence_context: To be honest, if you want authentic Sichuan hot pot, then you might not want to come here. The only good thing I'd say about this place is that the meat quality is decent; however, nothing else meets our expectations. We ordered extra spicy soup base, but it's not spicy at all, only a thin layer of chili oil floating on the top. I think the chili sauce from the sauce tray might even be spicier than the soup base, very disappointing. The service was okay, they never added the soup for us unless we asked them to do. But the most frustrating thing was that when we wanted to chat and stay for a bit after we paid the check, the waitresses just kept staring and looking at us like they wanted us to leave immediately. I don't think this is how customers should be treated here.
